svg.font-family: Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif
svg.text: 1.965B parameters (0.499B in Engram tables) · 386M active per token · vocab 65536 · d = 1024 · 24 layers
Depth attention over b0–b7 + block 8 → RMSNorm
Block outputs b0–b7, read by depth attention in every later layer (Block AttnRes)
Input: earlier block outputs + partial sum
Token mixer: KDA (18 layers) or full attention (6)
Output: partial sum += FFN output → next layer
First layer of a block: the previous partial sum becomes
a new block output and the partial sum restarts here
· Delta rule with per-channel forget gate
· Fixed-size state, compute linear in length
· Forget / output gates via rank-128 bottleneck
· Pattern KKKF: 3 KDA layers, then 1 full attention
Full attention (6 layers: L3, L7 … L23)
· GQA: 8 Q heads, 2 KV heads, head dim 128
· No positional encoding (NoPE); KDA supplies position
· The last layer is always full attention
· Router: sigmoid scores plus a per-expert bias
Active per token: 4 of 32 routed experts (0.145B) plus everything except the embedding and Engram lookups
